_howto: General lineout info for the Lineout page. items = what shows when you tap a part of the diagram. good = the 'Good to know' cards.

thrower.name: The thrower
thrower.text: The hooker throws the ball in from touch. It has to go straight down the middle, between the two lines.

jumper.name: Jumper
jumper.text: Gets lifted to catch the ball or tap it down to the receiver.

lifter.name: Lifter
lifter.text: Lifts the jumper on the thighs/shorts, holds them up, and brings them down safely. Never drop the jumper.

them.name: The other team's line
them.text: They line up 1 meter away and can lift and jump to compete for the throw.

gap.name: The gap
gap.text: The two lines stand about 1 meter apart, with a channel down the middle. The throw has to go straight down it.

zone.name: Where it happens
zone.text: The lineout is between the 5m line and the 15m line, in from where the ball went out.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.text: Each team can have a receiver (usually the 9), standing behind their own line, about 2 meters back and between the 5m and 15m lines.

backs.name: Everyone else
backs.text: Players not in the lineout stand at least 10 meters back until the lineout is over.

good.def: At least 2 from each team. The throwing team decides how many. The defense can match that or use fewer, but not more.
Some teams we play use a full lineout, with all of their forwards in the line. Count their numbers so we can match them.
Line up across from their players, 1 meter apart, with the channel between you. Watch their jumpers and get ready to contest or defend the maul.
We have set calls, often called by a jumper or a vet. Be ready to listen for the call, or to make it.
